name: numbat
tagline: Endpoint visibility into AI agent activity
description: numbat gives you endpoint visibility into AI agent activity, with on-device detection, optional pre-action blocking, and forensic reconstruction. It observes supported desktop, CLI, IDE, and gateway agents through local hooks and plugins, normalizes live and at-rest activity into one event model, and evaluates it with a CEL rule engine that runs entirely locally.
highlights: Live monitoring via local hooks, plugins, and OTLP/HTTP log exporters
Endpoint-local detection with built-in CEL rules and custom YAML rules
Opt-in pre-action blocking for supported synchronous hooks
Forensic reconstruction from on-disk session artifacts
Single-binary distribution for macOS, Linux, and Windows
curatorNote: Perplexity's young on-device agent-security monitor — under 800 stars despite the well-known parent org.
